purpose: Define safe navigation from a citizen-facing property answer into its verified timeline, events, parties/roles, interests, evidence, legal sources and official routes.
core_principle: ANSWER → SELECTED COMPONENT → VERIFIED DETAIL → SOURCE / NEXT ACTION

navigation_map.TIMELINE_EVENT: event details, state transition, evidence and law
navigation_map.INTEREST: holder/role, before-after state and legal basis
navigation_map.LEGAL_PROVISION: exact provision, version, conditions and official source
navigation_map.EVIDENCE_RECORD: safe evidence summary and official retrieval route
navigation_map.OFFICIAL_ROUTE: procedure, responsible body and next action
navigation_map.LIMITATION: reason for limitation and evidence needed if known

rules: Navigation may expose only information approved for the user's access level.
A drill-down must not create a new legal conclusion.
Selected detail must retain property and date scope.
Public navigation may show source summaries and official links but not restricted evidence.
Returning from a detail view must preserve the original answer snapshot.
A source page is not automatically evidence of the property-specific fact being investigated.
Limitations must remain visible when navigating to supporting detail.
hard_stops: Never expose restricted evidence through a public click path.
Never navigate from a general source to an unsupported property-specific conclusion.
Never silently change the answer snapshot during navigation.
Never hide limitations in detail views.
Never expose internal reasoning or system-only metadata.
